decision_rule: A15 post hoc / exploratory follow-up F2 (RESEARCH_TREE D18). §8 gate: the single candidate F2 (H1 + artefact-only B-loo W7-03 on M2(f=1)) is eligible iff its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1/M0, the W1 look's G-star) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum); m = 1, so σ·√(2 ln m) = 0 and the one-SE rule is trivial. P1 (M6:H1+Bloo/M2(f=1)) is descriptive and is never selected here. The F2 question is the validated cost of the safer variant, F2 − P1, read as Δ̄_lin(F2 − H1) − Δ̄_lin(P1 − H1) on the identical primary-cell lines (exact point estimate; no CI from the harness). No claim that F2 beats P1; it never replaces T1/T2 or the headline, and no test evaluation follows.
notes: Post hoc / exploratory (DESIGN §17 A15; RESEARCH_TREE D18, fixed before any F2 validation scoring). Milestone-level look M10 (A13), total cap only. F2 = Human1 + artefact-only biomass leave-out (W7-03; autoresearch/ideas.tsv): retinoid, vitamin-D and tocopherol catabolites and carnitine removed from the cofactor pool MAR10065 (results/w3/structure/variants_human1.json groups B-loo:retinoid_catabolites, B-loo:vitaminD_catabolites, B-loo:tocopherol_catabolites, B-loo:carnitine); ubiquinol, heme, lipoate, cobamide and the real cofactors stay. Medium: documented M2(f=1) per line, exactly P1's (results/m6/scores/line_assignment.tsv). Scores: e = 1 − ratio_r of the W7-03 KO sweep of the line's M2(f=1) signature (results/w7/sweeps), 198 validation expression lines x U; H1, H2 and P1 equal the M6 look's columns bitwise. Purpose: the validated cost F2 − P1 of the biologically safer variant. F2 fixes W3-MEV label-free: the mevalonate core (HMGCR, MVK, PMVK, MVD) is lethal on 19/19 serum M2(f=1) signatures and on the serum-free one (1,361/1,361 lines), against 0/19 for P1 (results/f2/mev_check.tsv). Training (W7 r4, post hoc; 686 lines, 12 lineages): F2 − G* +0.0304 [0.0294, 0.0313], 12/12; F2 − P1 −0.0230 [−0.0236, −0.0224], 0/12; the non-author recompute is results/f2/train/summary.json (D18 step 1). Flags carried by F2: W3-D1 (biomass leave-out, no pre-registered negative control), W2-SHUF and W2-MOPEN (medium); W3-MEV is lifted. The F2 agent did not open T1/T2 outputs, results/m6/test/ or results/f3/ (A15 blindness).
